voice/en/brock/arc_actThree_0_5923af69.w.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_actThree_0_5923af69.w.spokenText: This deep, the maps stop helping. This deep, Camp Hearthwood stops being the last camp on the ridge and starts being the last camp, period.

voice/en/brock/arc_actThree_1_5d799309.w.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_actThree_1_5d799309.w.spokenText: Bring back whatever you find. I am done being surprised at my age. I would just like to be informed.

voice/en/brock/arc_actTwo_0_b387600c.web.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_actTwo_0_b387600c.web.spokenText: You are past the treeline proper now. Further than I go. Further than most of my old troop got. Different makers stamp those tokens out there. Different hands, different tin. They compete. I do not know for what.

voice/en/brock/arc_actTwo_1_3d8f8fa3.web.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_actTwo_1_3d8f8fa3.web.spokenText: Bring me one, if you can pry it loose. I have wanted to look at one up close for thirty years. I have also, and I cannot stress this enough, been too much of a coward.

voice/en/brock/arc_behindDown_0_bc5024a2.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_behindDown_0_bc5024a2.spokenText: THE BEHIND. In thirty years not one scout has been able to tell me what it looks like, and I notice you have not offered either.

voice/en/brock/arc_behindDown_1_871875a4.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_behindDown_1_871875a4.spokenText: Do not. I have thought about it every night since I was younger than you and I have decided I would rather go on not knowing. Eat something.

voice/en/brock/arc_brambleDown_0_a15ea9d.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_brambleDown_0_a15ea9d.spokenText: BRAMBLEBUCK, down. First one Signed, if the old stories are even true, which means you just beat the one with seniority.

voice/en/brock/arc_brambleDown_1_c9087a7.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_brambleDown_1_c9087a7.spokenText: Do not let it go to your head. It was, and I want to stress this, a rabbit.

voice/en/brock/arc_finalDown_0_1b39d9c7..speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_finalDown_0_1b39d9c7..spokenText: OLD NOBODY. HOLLOWANTLER, if you want its whole name, though nothing out there wants to hear it said twice. Down. Thirty years running this camp did not prepare me for how quiet that would be.

voice/en/brock/arc_finalDown_1_8386e210..speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_finalDown_1_8386e210..spokenText: I had a whole speech ready. I am not giving it tonight. Go celebrate. And do not ask me about the twelfth name yet. Some other night.

voice/en/brock/arc_firstDawn_0_31201393..speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_firstDawn_0_31201393..spokenText: You saw a whole dawn out there and came back to tell me about it. Sit by the fire. The actual seat, not the log with the splinter.

voice/en/brock/arc_firstDawn_1_e3fe7575..speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_firstDawn_1_e3fe7575..spokenText: Thirty years I ran this camp on the theory that somebody eventually would. Thank you for proving the theory. Cocoa is on me tonight.

voice/en/brock/arc_firstNight_0_c0fe516c.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_firstNight_0_c0fe516c.spokenText: Back already. Good. That means you are still breathing. Sit. I only tell this story once, and I am not repeating the good parts.

voice/en/brock/arc_firstNight_1_15eef9c6.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_firstNight_1_15eef9c6.spokenText: Thirty years ago I brought twelve kids up this ridge. I brought one down. That is a fireside talk for later. Tonight, go get badges.

voice/en/brock/arc_firstPage_0_55de5095..speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_firstPage_0_55de5095..spokenText: You are keeping notes. Good. Nobody who ever camped this ridge before you wrote a single thing down, and look how that went.

voice/en/brock/arc_firstPage_1_0bdd393b..speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_firstPage_1_0bdd393b..spokenText: Keep the journal. I will read it when you are done needing it. Preferably a long time from now.

voice/en/brock/arc_fiveGraves_0_b03e5075.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_fiveGraves_0_b03e5075.spokenText: Five times back to this fire in a body bag, more or less. I stopped flinching around number three. Professional courtesy.

voice/en/brock/arc_fiveGraves_1_5cb3e280.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_fiveGraves_1_5cb3e280.spokenText: You keep coming back, though. That is either grit or a badge quota you are very committed to. I am choosing to believe grit.

voice/en/brock/arc_fullJournal_0_9be30a2.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_fullJournal_0_9be30a2.spokenText: That journal of yours is getting thick. You have written down more about this ridge than I managed in thirty years, and I LIVE here.

voice/en/brock/arc_fullJournal_1_9b343b3.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_fullJournal_1_9b343b3.spokenText: Feel free to be smug about it. Once.

voice/en/brock/arc_tallymanDown_0_7bfb87.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_tallymanDown_0_7bfb87.spokenText: THE TALLYMAN, finally handled. He has been walking off with badges since before you were born. Did you get any of them back?

voice/en/brock/arc_tallymanDown_1_14e550.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_tallymanDown_1_14e550.spokenText: No? Of course not. He is very organized about it. There is probably a ledger.

voice/en/brock/arc_threeKills_0_33f97676.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_threeKills_0_33f97676.spokenText: Three of the named ones, put down for good. That is not luck, kid. That is a pattern. I am almost proud, which is new for me.

voice/en/brock/arc_threeKills_1_ec9996ef.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_threeKills_1_ec9996ef.spokenText: Try not to let it go to your head twice in one season.

voice/en/brock/arc_twoMarks_0_fd021eaf.w.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_twoMarks_0_fd021eaf.w.spokenText: You have gotten a good look at two of them now. Notice the tin? Every marked critter wears one, pressed right into the fur. Somebody out there is stamping those by hand.

voice/en/brock/arc_twoMarks_1_f6f55f7b.w.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/arc_twoMarks_1_f6f55f7b.w.spokenText: Do not ask me who. I have theories. None of them let me sleep.

voice/en/brock/blink_0_c7733c6f.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/blink_0_c7733c6f.webm.spokenText: That bug follows you everywhere now. I do not name wildlife. If I did, which I do not, that one is Blink.

voice/en/brock/blink_1_a6b105ae.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/blink_1_a6b105ae.webm.spokenText: Your firefly sat on my ledger hand for an hour last night. Got nothing done. It can stay.

voice/en/brock/blink_2_f9177a34.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/blink_2_f9177a34.webm.spokenText: Thirty years on this ridge and the woods finally sent us something that is not trying to eat anyone. Do not tell it I said that.

voice/en/brock/dawn_0_0da071c1.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/dawn_0_0da071c1.webm.spokenText: You saw the dawn. Thirty years I have run this camp and I can count dawn-watchers on one paw.

voice/en/brock/dawn_1_e6a842ce.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/dawn_1_e6a842ce.webm.spokenText: OLD NOBODY is down and the sun came up. Do not get comfortable. Antlers grow back, and so, probably, does he.

voice/en/brock/dawn_2_8dff7314.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/dawn_2_8dff7314.webm.spokenText: THE BEHIND is down and the sun came up. Thirty years I have felt something at my shoulder on this ridge. This morning there is nothing there, and I find I do not know what to do with my hands.

voice/en/brock/died_antlered_0b46c734.we.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_antlered_0b46c734.we.spokenText: OLD NOBODY. HOLLOWANTLER, if you want its whole name, though nobody out there wants to be caught saying it twice. You got further than most of Troop 12 ever did. Again.

voice/en/brock/died_bat_379a99e1.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_bat_379a99e1.webm.spokenText: Bats. Hate the wobble. Everyone hates the wobble.

voice/en/brock/died_beaver_eacee1d4.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_beaver_eacee1d4.webm.spokenText: A beaver. Death by municipal engineering. There is a badge for irony somewhere.

voice/en/brock/died_behind_3a67879e.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_behind_3a67879e.webm.spokenText: THE BEHIND. You cannot shoot a thing that is not there, and it is never there. Take the cover away from it. Every stump you break is one less place in the world for it to stand.

voice/en/brock/died_boar_gus_5d115548.we.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_boar_gus_5d115548.we.spokenText: Boars telegraph the charge. Big exclamation of intent. Step LEFT, big fella.

voice/en/brock/died_boar_junie_4ae2bbfe..speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_boar_junie_4ae2bbfe..spokenText: Boars telegraph the charge. Big exclamation of intent. Step LEFT, the fire hazard.

voice/en/brock/died_boar_max_ab65ea43.we.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_boar_max_ab65ea43.we.spokenText: Boars telegraph the charge. Big exclamation of intent. Step LEFT, squad leader.

voice/en/brock/died_doe_166b2f9a.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_doe_166b2f9a.webm.spokenText: Killed by a doe. Gentle eyes, they said. Nature is healing, they said.

voice/en/brock/died_fox_768165f9.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_fox_768165f9.webm.spokenText: Foxes weave. Stop shooting where they were and shoot where they are going.

voice/en/brock/died_generic_gus_bd86c803.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_generic_gus_bd86c803.spokenText: Back again, big fella. The forest keeps score, and so do I. Spend some badges before you go back out.

voice/en/brock/died_generic_junie_4c82b7.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_generic_junie_4c82b7.spokenText: Back again, the fire hazard. The forest keeps score, and so do I. Spend some badges before you go back out.

voice/en/brock/died_generic_max_4be6f503.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_generic_max_4be6f503.spokenText: Back again, squad leader. The forest keeps score, and so do I. Spend some badges before you go back out.

voice/en/brock/died_hare_b8bb780e.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_hare_b8bb780e.webm.spokenText: BRAMBLEBUCK. Signed young, they say, back when the tokens were still hand stamped. Every third landing it sprays. Count the hops, kid.

voice/en/brock/died_mole_gus_d37a7ef9.we.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_mole_gus_d37a7ef9.we.spokenText: MAWMOLE. Blind since before either of us was born and it has never once needed eyes: every shot you fire is you telling it exactly where to come up. It is only worth hitting when the nose is out, big fella. The rest is dirt.

voice/en/brock/died_mole_junie_6e950e29..speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_mole_junie_6e950e29..spokenText: MAWMOLE. Blind since before either of us was born and it has never once needed eyes: every shot you fire is you telling it exactly where to come up. It is only worth hitting when the nose is out, the fire hazard. The rest is dirt.

voice/en/brock/died_mole_max_05af267f.we.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_mole_max_05af267f.we.spokenText: MAWMOLE. Blind since before either of us was born and it has never once needed eyes: every shot you fire is you telling it exactly where to come up. It is only worth hitting when the nose is out, squad leader. The rest is dirt.

voice/en/brock/died_owl_a6c714b5.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_owl_a6c714b5.webm.spokenText: The owls spit feathers. Keep your feet moving and they cannot lead the shot.

voice/en/brock/died_rabbit_gus_a3788fd0..speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_rabbit_gus_a3788fd0..spokenText: A rabbit got you. They hop, big fella. You can see the whole attack coming from the air.

voice/en/brock/died_rabbit_junie_83be854.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_rabbit_junie_83be854.spokenText: A rabbit got you. They hop, the fire hazard. You can see the whole attack coming from the air.

voice/en/brock/died_rabbit_max_ee16c88d..speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_rabbit_max_ee16c88d..spokenText: A rabbit got you. They hop, squad leader. You can see the whole attack coming from the air.

voice/en/brock/died_raccoon_43593b04.web.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_raccoon_43593b04.web.spokenText: A raccoon. It probably went through your pack afterwards. They always do.

voice/en/brock/died_squirrel_2be9be6b.we.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_squirrel_2be9be6b.we.spokenText: A squirrel. You were bested by a SQUIRREL. I have led this troop thirty years and it does not get less embarrassing.

voice/en/brock/died_vicar_26dd454d.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/died_vicar_26dd454d.webm.spokenText: THE TALLYMAN got you. Everything you own, he considers a loan. Stay off his rings and mind the raccoons he calls.

voice/en/brock/idle_0_18a68ee5.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/idle_0_18a68ee5.webm.spokenText: The Badge Board takes badges, not promises.

voice/en/brock/idle_1_5cf36e81.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/idle_1_5cf36e81.webm.spokenText: Cocoa heals. That is not camp wisdom, that is medical fact out here.

voice/en/brock/idle_2_1141e68e.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/idle_2_1141e68e.webm.spokenText: Hold your ground near the fire all you want. Out there, keep moving.

voice/en/brock/idle_3_ea199324.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/idle_3_ea199324.webm.spokenText: Elites glow red. Chests fall out of them. Draw your own conclusions.

voice/en/brock/idle_4_b7cecb1c.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/idle_4_b7cecb1c.webm.spokenText: I knew that stag when he was a fawn. Before he got Signed. Shame. Great rack, though.

voice/en/brock/idle_5_d2636eea.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/idle_5_d2636eea.webm.spokenText: Second Wind is not a myth. It is a purchase.

voice/en/brock/idle_6_gus_7a882434.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/idle_6_gus_7a882434.webm.spokenText: You aim with your eyes, not your feet. Strafe, big fella. Strafe.

voice/en/brock/idle_6_junie_d7eaab6c.web.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/idle_6_junie_d7eaab6c.web.spokenText: You aim with your eyes, not your feet. Strafe, the fire hazard. Strafe.

voice/en/brock/idle_6_max_23cbb370.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/idle_6_max_23cbb370.webm.spokenText: You aim with your eyes, not your feet. Strafe, squad leader. Strafe.

voice/en/brock/intro_0_7c5febee.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/intro_0_7c5febee.webm.spokenText: New blood. Good. Every critter out here that has truly seen one of them believes forever after, and belief like that leaves a mark, a little tin stamp pressed into the fur. We call that getting Signed. Earn badges. Come back alive. In that order, preferably.

voice/en/brock/intro_1_8277ea7d.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/intro_1_8277ea7d.webm.spokenText: Rules of Camp Hearthwood: respect the fire, bank your badges, and if a rabbit smiles at you, it already believes in something you really do not want it to.

voice/en/brock/totem_0_fe41088b.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/totem_0_fe41088b.webm.spokenText: You put a hatchet to the post. Thirty years that thing stood there with the bark on and nobody touched it. Now it is marked. Now it is marked several times.

voice/en/brock/totem_1_1fe376c8.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/totem_1_1fe376c8.webm.spokenText: Every blaze on that post is a promise, and out there they read promises the way you read a trail sign. Loudly, and from a long way off.

voice/en/brock/totem_2_e2be4679.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/totem_2_e2be4679.webm.spokenText: The badges do come back heavier. I have counted. I would like the record to show I counted while disapproving.

voice/en/brock/totem_3_1a9fc9d0.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/totem_3_1a9fc9d0.webm.spokenText: You can plane it smooth, you know. Any night you like. Nobody out there has ever been told a promise came off, but you are welcome to try.

voice/en/brock/totem_4_0b6b18a2.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/totem_4_0b6b18a2.webm.spokenText: I watched a scout cut four blazes and walk out whistling. He came back. He did not whistle.

voice/en/brock/totem_5_b5a89227.webm.speaker: brock
voice/en/brock/totem_5_b5a89227.webm.spokenText: Marking wood to say you were here. That is their habit, not ours. And the woods have never once failed to notice.

voice/en/gus/boss_0_34a73ca2.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/boss_0_34a73ca2.webm.spokenText: That is a lot of critter.

voice/en/gus/boss_1_2108c7c9.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/boss_1_2108c7c9.webm.spokenText: You look like you skip breakfast.

voice/en/gus/boss_2_a4a7ca23.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/boss_2_a4a7ca23.webm.spokenText: I have a skillet with your name on it.

voice/en/gus/boss_3_10493804.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/boss_3_10493804.webm.spokenText: Oh, this one has a whole legend. Fancy.

voice/en/gus/boss_5_721a42ec.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/boss_5_721a42ec.webm.spokenText: I have been hungrier than this. Barely.

voice/en/gus/bossnamed_antlered_fc751eb5.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/bossnamed_antlered_fc751eb5.spokenText: OLD NOBODY. I have skipped fewer meals than you have skipped centuries.

voice/en/gus/bossnamed_behind_dbcb50e1.w.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/bossnamed_behind_dbcb50e1.w.spokenText: THE BEHIND. Nope. I am facing this way now. Permanently.

voice/en/gus/bossnamed_hare_ee041cad.web.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/bossnamed_hare_ee041cad.web.spokenText: The hopping one. I have heard the stories. Underwhelming so far.

voice/en/gus/bossnamed_mole_a87b9fc1.web.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/bossnamed_mole_a87b9fc1.web.spokenText: MAWMOLE. All that digging and it still has not found lunch.

voice/en/gus/bossnamed_vicar_8f297422.we.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/bossnamed_vicar_8f297422.we.spokenText: You are not getting my snacks. Try the badges instead.

voice/en/gus/chest_1_1693234c.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/chest_1_1693234c.webm.spokenText: Is there food in this one?

voice/en/gus/death_1_726e1401.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/death_1_726e1401.webm.spokenText: Do not let this go to waste... any of it...

voice/en/gus/death_2_486a093b.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/death_2_486a093b.webm.spokenText: Tell them I finished my snacks first...

voice/en/gus/death_3_d302be33.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/death_3_d302be33.webm.spokenText: Worth it. The snacks were worth it...

voice/en/gus/kills_1_50ab6a06.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/kills_1_50ab6a06.webm.spokenText: A hundred down. Arms are noodles.

voice/en/gus/lowhp_0_b27b6357.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/lowhp_0_b27b6357.webm.spokenText: I have been hit in the snacks.

voice/en/gus/lowhp_1_22f14511.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/lowhp_1_22f14511.webm.spokenText: Everything hurts. Even the trail mix.

voice/en/gus/lowhp_2_06822e9d.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/lowhp_2_06822e9d.webm.spokenText: Walk it off. Walk it off.

voice/en/gus/lowhp_3_4a4ef832.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/lowhp_3_4a4ef832.webm.spokenText: That woke me up, at least.

voice/en/gus/lowhp_4_7009d43c.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/lowhp_4_7009d43c.webm.spokenText: I am fine. The trail mix is not.

voice/en/gus/runstart_3_d4627e66.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/runstart_3_d4627e66.webm.spokenText: Whatever it believes in, I believe in lunch.

voice/en/gus/runstart_4_5f9a2b74.webm.speaker: gus
voice/en/gus/runstart_4_5f9a2b74.webm.spokenText: Let us get this over with, I am hungry.

voice/en/hare/bossline_0_512cf885.webm.speaker: hare
voice/en/hare/bossline_0_512cf885.webm.spokenText: hold still. it is only a pin.

voice/en/junie/boss_1_d5a3a4e8.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/boss_1_d5a3a4e8.webm.spokenText: You ever seen a deer cry? Wanna?

voice/en/junie/boss_2_ec5355be.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/boss_2_ec5355be.webm.spokenText: I am going to need more marshmallows.

voice/en/junie/boss_3_0ae94fbb.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/boss_3_0ae94fbb.webm.spokenText: It has a WHOLE NAME. I am so excited.

voice/en/junie/boss_4_0201a0aa.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/boss_4_0201a0aa.webm.spokenText: Ooh, it is famous. Famous things burn great.

voice/en/junie/bossnamed_antlered_030ec1.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/bossnamed_antlered_030ec1.spokenText: Big Nobody! I brought extra matches, just for you!

voice/en/junie/bossnamed_behind_aacf5247.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/bossnamed_behind_aacf5247.spokenText: I keep looking and it keeps not being there. I hate it. I love it.

voice/en/junie/bossnamed_hare_50ccc8fa.w.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/bossnamed_hare_50ccc8fa.w.spokenText: BRAMBLEBUCK! I have wanted to meet you since orientation!

voice/en/junie/bossnamed_mole_d10f38fb.w.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/bossnamed_mole_d10f38fb.w.spokenText: It is blind! HEY! OVER HERE! I am the loudest thing alive!

voice/en/junie/death_2_acbaaf8e.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/death_2_acbaaf8e.webm.spokenText: Tell the marshmallows... I loved them...

voice/en/junie/death_3_e0da2a62.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/death_3_e0da2a62.webm.spokenText: This is... a really bad campfire story...

voice/en/junie/death_4_16f9ffa9.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/death_4_16f9ffa9.webm.spokenText: I bet I still... look cool...

voice/en/junie/kills_0_59b7de3b.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/kills_0_59b7de3b.webm.spokenText: I lost count at a hundred!

voice/en/junie/lowhp_3_2c94b130.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/lowhp_3_2c94b130.webm.spokenText: That is going to leave a hilarious scar.

voice/en/junie/lowhp_5_63cd66b3.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/lowhp_5_63cd66b3.webm.spokenText: Still on fire! Wait, is that me?

voice/en/junie/revive_0_9fb8ef67.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/revive_0_9fb8ef67.webm.spokenText: Can not stop, will not stop.

voice/en/junie/runstart_0_82d000fd.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/runstart_0_82d000fd.webm.spokenText: Time to earn my FIRE badge.

voice/en/junie/runstart_1_6d5c3e06.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/runstart_1_6d5c3e06.webm.spokenText: Ha ha ha ha. Okay. Focus.

voice/en/junie/runstart_3_65452274.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/runstart_3_65452274.webm.spokenText: They are all Signed and I am ALL fire.

voice/en/junie/runstart_4_063d9895.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/runstart_4_063d9895.webm.spokenText: Who wants to see something get REALLY believed in.

voice/en/junie/runstart_5_715dcf14.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/runstart_5_715dcf14.webm.spokenText: Focus. Focus. Fire first, focus second.

voice/en/junie/select_0_9f779df4.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/select_0_9f779df4.webm.spokenText: I already lit the roaster. It is not even dark yet.

voice/en/junie/win_0_a01807a1.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/win_0_a01807a1.webm.spokenText: The sun! My other favorite fire!

voice/en/junie/win_1_938c687f.webm.speaker: junie
voice/en/junie/win_1_938c687f.webm.spokenText: We won! Nobody check the forest.

voice/en/max/boss_0_82e4f1c6.webm.speaker: max
voice/en/max/boss_0_82e4f1c6.webm.spokenText: That one has a title. Great.

voice/en/max/boss_2_358150b5.webm.speaker: max
voice/en/max/boss_2_358150b5.webm.spokenText: Big ones fall the same way.

voice/en/max/boss_3_e890c4b4.webm.speaker: max
voice/en/max/boss_3_e890c4b4.webm.spokenText: It has a name. Do not learn it.

voice/en/max/boss_4_06ab9afc.webm.speaker: max
voice/en/max/boss_4_06ab9afc.webm.spokenText: Hold the line like Brock taught us.

voice/en/max/boss_5_1240bfd2.webm.speaker: max
voice/en/max/boss_5_1240bfd2.webm.spokenText: Big or small, it still counts as one badge.

voice/en/max/bossnamed_antlered_75fd5397.speaker: max
voice/en/max/bossnamed_antlered_75fd5397.spokenText: Troop 13. Hold the line. That is an order and a request.

voice/en/max/bossnamed_behind_7b3d00db.w.speaker: max
voice/en/max/bossnamed_behind_7b3d00db.w.spokenText: Nobody turns around. Nobody. Eyes front, Troop 13.

voice/en/max/bossnamed_hare_6162cb0b.web.speaker: max
voice/en/max/bossnamed_hare_6162cb0b.web.spokenText: Hold still, it says. Like that has ever worked.

voice/en/max/bossnamed_mole_97238fa6.web.speaker: max
voice/en/max/bossnamed_mole_97238fa6.web.spokenText: It wants noise. Then we give it noise, together, on my mark.

voice/en/max/bossnamed_vicar_2dc29a1f.we.speaker: max
voice/en/max/bossnamed_vicar_2dc29a1f.we.spokenText: Nothing here is owed to you. Move.

voice/en/max/death_2_ae9d443d.webm.speaker: max
voice/en/max/death_2_ae9d443d.webm.spokenText: Tell Brock... I held the line...

voice/en/max/death_3_e03f7b0b.webm.speaker: max
voice/en/max/death_3_e03f7b0b.webm.spokenText: It is fine. This is fine. Mostly fine.

voice/en/max/kills_0_66de3350.webm.speaker: max
voice/en/max/kills_0_66de3350.webm.spokenText: That is a lot of paperwork.

voice/en/max/lowhp_0_cdfff83d.webm.speaker: max
voice/en/max/lowhp_0_cdfff83d.webm.spokenText: Just a scratch. A big scratch.

voice/en/max/lowhp_3_3375a4af.webm.speaker: max
voice/en/max/lowhp_3_3375a4af.webm.spokenText: I have had worse at scout camp. Probably.

voice/en/max/lowhp_4_1e9a5134.webm.speaker: max
voice/en/max/lowhp_4_1e9a5134.webm.spokenText: Troop 13 does not quit at half health.

voice/en/max/runstart_3_99fae9a1.webm.speaker: max
voice/en/max/runstart_3_99fae9a1.webm.spokenText: Nobody gets Signed tonight. Not on my watch.

voice/en/max/runstart_5_c4833708.webm.speaker: max
voice/en/max/runstart_5_c4833708.webm.spokenText: Stay together. Camp Hearthwood does not do rescues twice.

voice/en/max/select_0_5fb2acbc.webm.speaker: max
voice/en/max/select_0_5fb2acbc.webm.spokenText: Troop 13 does not run. Not from squirrels.

voice/en/max/win_1_3783fe27.webm.speaker: max
voice/en/max/win_1_3783fe27.webm.spokenText: Report: everything is on fire, sir.

voice/en/qm/coins_0_0556d322.webm.speaker: qm
voice/en/qm/coins_0_0556d322.webm.spokenText: Your Cookie Money from last night cleared. Counted, converted, logged, stamped. If the badge number felt small, take it up with the ledger. The ledger does not care.

voice/en/qm/idle_0_fcfdb01b.webm.speaker: qm
voice/en/qm/idle_0_fcfdb01b.webm.spokenText: Requisition forms are in triplicate now. The forest keeps eating the second copy.

voice/en/qm/idle_1_68fc94ec.webm.speaker: qm
voice/en/qm/idle_1_68fc94ec.webm.spokenText: We are down to four tin cups. If a raccoon has the fifth, it signed nothing for it.

voice/en/qm/idle_2_eac9a9b0.webm.speaker: qm
voice/en/qm/idle_2_eac9a9b0.webm.spokenText: Cookie Money is not legal tender. It is cookie money. It becomes badges at my table and nowhere else, and the rate is fair because I set it.

voice/en/qm/idle_3_78f47eb6.webm.speaker: qm
voice/en/qm/idle_3_78f47eb6.webm.spokenText: Do not ask what is in the barrels. They are labeled. The label says BARREL.

voice/en/qm/idle_4_04853272.webm.speaker: qm
voice/en/qm/idle_4_04853272.webm.spokenText: I count marshmallows by the bag, not the piece. Learned that the hard way. Junie was involved.

voice/en/qm/idle_5_72803cb2.webm.speaker: qm
voice/en/qm/idle_5_72803cb2.webm.spokenText: Lost and found out here is the whole forest, kid. Found is just the part I keep on shelves.

voice/en/qm/intro_0_3a55052b.webm.speaker: qm
voice/en/qm/intro_0_3a55052b.webm.spokenText: Name? Not yours. The inventory has names. You are the thing that makes the inventory smaller.
